common:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: One full-screen desktop reference screenshot for the existing Virtual Company business application. This is a proposed design, using fictional demonstration data, not a screenshot of running software.
Style: implementable premium SaaS interface based on repository docs/design.md. Inter font, semibold headings, crisp 14-16px readable body text, navy text, #F7F9FC workspace, white surfaces, #2563EB primary actions, restrained green/amber/red status accents accompanied by words. Light borders, 12px radius, restrained shadows. Calm Nordic business software. No gradients, glass, neon, robots, sparkles or decorative illustrations.
Composition: landscape 16:10 canvas, straight-on pixel-sharp full application screenshot without a browser frame or laptop. Dark navy 240px left sidebar; spacious central workspace; narrower right rail for relevant evidence, decisions and agent outcomes. Use the entire canvas. All text should be legible and spelled correctly. No multiple screens, collage or mobile inset.
Shared shell: wordmark "Virtual Company", company selector "Northstar AB". Sidebar order "Overview", "Agent team", "Finance", "Sales", "Marketing", "Support", "Work"; bottom "History", "Settings". Active navigation item blue tint. Top right small user avatar and "Johan". In the workspace header a perspective selector, and consistent time selector "Today  Week  Month  Quarter  Year  3 years" with the requested horizon clearly selected. If this is a settings or collaboration detail, show a clear breadcrumb instead of irrelevant time filters.
Hierarchy: prioritize an actionable headline, at most four compact metrics, 3–5 ranked actions, and a contextual right rail. Every priority has impact, owner, due time and one clear action. Show source freshness near evidence. Agent portraits are small neutral initials avatars with explicit "AI agent" role labels.
Footer in unobtrusive small readable type: "Design concept · Illustrative data". All amounts use SEK or SEK m consistently; dates and times use Europe/Stockholm. Screen content is specified below.

screens.title: CEO — morning decisions
screens.caption: Company health, three consequential decisions and verified agent outcomes.
screens.spec:
Perspective "Company / CEO", Today selected. Title "Good morning, Johan". Date "Thursday, 1 October 2026 · 09:10". Lead sentence "Two decisions need you before noon."
Three small metrics: "Cash buffer 4.2 months", "Revenue vs plan +6%", "Renewals at risk SEK 240k". Source strip "CRM 09:05 · Ledger 08:50 · Bank 09:02".
Large central "Your priorities" list with three numbered spacious rows: "Review Northstar renewal terms" with "SEK 240k renewal · Margin exception · Due 11:00" and "Review proposal"; "Resolve disputed supplier bill" with "SEK 48k · Payment held · Due today" and "Open evidence"; "Confirm October campaign budget" with "SEK 80k proposal · Due Friday" and "Review budget". All owners named.
Below a compact horizontal company health section for Finance, Sales, Marketing, Support, with one sentence each.
Right rail "Your AI team" with Laura "Reconciled 18 transactions · Verified"; Alex "Renewal proposal ready · Needs your decision"; Maya "Campaign attribution delayed · Waiting for data". Bottom small "Since yesterday: 12 outcomes verified · 2 need attention", link "Open Agent team". No giant chat pane.

screens.title: Sales — deals and the working day
screens.caption: Meeting preparation, next actions and commercial exceptions in one workspace.
screens.spec:
Sales navigation active. Perspective "Sales", Today selected. Title "Move today's deals forward". Date "1 October 2026". Subtitle "3 follow-ups due · 1 pricing decision".
Three compact metrics "This month SEK 820k / 1.0m", "At-risk pipeline SEK 240k", "Next meeting 10:30". Clearly label quota as month-to-date, not today's total.
Central split: larger ranked opportunity table with columns "Opportunity", "Next step", "Value", "Due", "Owner". Rows "Northstar renewal / Resolve margin exception / SEK 240k / 11:00 / Johan", "Baltic Services / Review meeting brief / SEK 180k / 10:30 / Emma", "Harbor Group / Send revised proposal / SEK 95k / 15:00 / Johan". Selected Northstar row blue accent.
Below a compact day agenda with meeting 10:30, follow-up block 13:00, forecast review 16:00.
Right rail Alex, Sales AI agent: "I prepared the renewal brief. Finance recommends a smaller discount." White evidence card shows "Requested discount 12%", "Policy limit 8%", "Customer reply draft ready". Primary "Review proposal", secondary "View handoffs". Bottom "CRM refreshed 09:05". No send button that bypasses the pricing review.

screens.title: Marketing — weekly delivery and learning
screens.caption: Campaign priorities, publishing dependencies and evidence of commercial impact.
screens.spec:
Marketing navigation active. Perspective "Marketing", Week selected. Title "This week's campaigns". Date range "28 Sep–4 Oct 2026 · Week in progress". Subtitle "Launch the autumn campaign and review one experiment".
Four compact metrics "Qualified leads 42", "Budget used SEK 31k / 80k", "Content due 5", "Attribution delayed". Clearly label last metric amber with "Ad source last synced yesterday".
Central lightweight week planning board with columns "Mon 28", "Tue 29", "Wed 30", "Thu 1", "Fri 2"; cards for Brief approved, Landing page reviewed, Email ready, Launch awaiting review, Experiment review. Use small states and assignees, clear Thursday current-day marker.
Below "Decisions and learning" with two readable rows: "Approve autumn campaign copy" due today, button "Review copy"; "Evaluate headline experiment" with "Sample too small for a conclusion" and "Open experiment".
Right rail Maya, Marketing AI agent: "Drafts are ready. Launch waits for brand approval." A three-step handoff strip "Maya: audience brief → Alex: lead criteria → Johan: approve launch", and "Revenue attribution unavailable" with "Connect source". Do not falsely attribute revenue to missing data.

screens.title: Finance — month close and cash decisions
screens.caption: A close checklist, exceptions and separate accounting and cash measures.
screens.spec:
Finance navigation active. Perspective "Finance / Accounting", Month selected. Title "September close". Period "1–30 September 2026 · Compared with August". Status amber "Preliminary · 2 close blockers".
Four compact metrics "Revenue SEK 1.42m", "Operating result SEK 182k", "Cash balance SEK 910k", "Unreconciled items 7". Sources underneath "Ledger 08:50 · Bank 09:02".
Main surface left "Close checklist" with completed "Bank import", completed "Receivables review", attention "Reconcile 7 transactions", attention "Review 2 accruals", locked "Finalize period". Label completed 2 of 5, not percent guessed by AI.
Below "Exceptions requiring review" two rows: "Supplier bill missing evidence · SEK 48k" button "Review bill"; "Accrual proposal · SEK 12k" button "Review draft". A slim document row links "Resultaträkning", "Balansräkning", "Cash forecast" as three distinct report destinations.
Right rail Laura, Finance AI agent: "18 transactions matched. Two accrual drafts need review." Evidence mini-list with matched entries and source counts. Prominent text "Payment release requires an authorized approver". Bottom button "Open close workspace". Use clear preliminary versus posted states, no auto-approval of financial actions.

screens.title: Support — live attention and resolution
screens.caption: SLA risk, customer context, grounded drafts and specialist handoffs.
screens.spec:
Support navigation active. Perspective "Customer support", Today selected, small subfilter "Now" active beside "Shift summary". Title "Keep customers moving". Timestamp "Thursday 09:10 · Live queue".
Three compact metrics "Open cases 28", "SLA at risk 3", "Awaiting customer 7". Note "Queue updated 09:09".
Main table "Needs attention" columns "Case / Customer", "Impact", "SLA", "Next action", "Owner". Rows "#1042 Baltic Services / Checkout blocked / 18 min left / Review reply / Sofia", "#1039 Harbor Group / Billing dispute / 42 min left / Finance reviewing / Laura", "#1032 Northstar AB / Access request / 1 h 20 min / Confirm identity / Amir". Selected first row.
Lower selected case pane contains latest customer message and a concise draft answer labeled "Draft · Not sent". Source chips "Service status 09:08" and "Help article updated 25 Sep". Primary "Review and send" and secondary "Edit draft"; clear warning if sources insufficient.
Right rail Ben, Support AI agent, "Prepared 8 replies · 6 reviewed · 2 need evidence". One collaboration card "Billing dispute: Ben → Laura" with "Waiting for invoice check · Owner Laura · Expected 10:00". Compact "Reply policy: draft first". Emphasize solving customer needs rather than agent message count.

screens.title: CEO — annual plan and accountability
screens.caption: Yearly targets, quarterly commitments and explicit investment decisions.
screens.spec:
Overview active. Perspective "Company / CEO", Year selected. Title "2027 operating plan". Date selector "Fiscal year 2027". Badge "Draft plan". Comparison "2026 forecast → 2027 target".
Four compact result blocks "Revenue SEK 16.8m → 20.0m", "Operating margin 13% → 16%", "Cash buffer 4 → 6 months", "Retention 91% → 94%". Label all right values "Target".
Main large objective table columns "Objective", "Accountable owner", "Milestones", "Funding", "Status". Three rows "Build repeatable Nordic sales / Emma / Q1 pilot · Q2 rollout / SEK 600k / Proposed"; "Improve onboarding / Sofia / Q1 redesign · Q3 review / SEK 240k / Proposed"; "Shorten close cycle / Johan / Q2 five-day close / SEK 120k / Approved". Below simple Q1–Q4 milestone timeline with a visible present/future distinction.
Right rail "Decisions for the annual review" card "Approve Nordic pilot funding" with "SEK 200k first tranche" and "Review investment"; card "Capacity gap in Q2" with "1 role requires planning". AI team note "Finance, Sales and Support contributions attached". Button "Review plan changes", secondary "Open board pack". Do not imply draft targets are actual results or that a plan approval releases payments.

screens.title: CEO — three-year scenarios
screens.caption: Assumptions, ranges, dependencies and checkpoints for strategic choices.
screens.spec:
Overview active. Perspective "Company / CEO", 3 years selected. Title "Choose the next growth path". Period "2027–2029". Visible badge "Scenario · Not a commitment".
Top scenario tabs "Conservative", "Base case" selected, "Expansion". Subtitle "Model version 3 · Assumptions reviewed 1 Oct 2026".
Main wide chart titled "Revenue scenarios · SEK m", three clearly labeled paths and shaded ranges for 2027, 2028, 2029, baseline 2026 actual/forecast separated by dashed vertical line. Modest legible values base 20,24,28. Label "Illustrative scenario ranges, not probabilities".
Below two spacious panels: "What must be true" with three assumptions "Retention at least 92%", "Sales capacity grows in Q2 2027", "Expansion funding approved"; "Strategic checkpoints" with "2027: prove Nordic demand", "2028: scale only after unit economics review", "2029: consider second market".
Right rail "Assumptions" contains editable-looking numeric fields "Annual growth 18%", "Gross margin 62%", "Hiring +2 in 2027" and button "Recalculate scenario". Second card "Trade-off" says "Expansion grows revenue faster but reduces cash buffer." Buttons "Compare assumptions" and "Create review task". No autonomous investment execution and no false precision on forecast confidence.

screens.title: Agent team — shared outcome and handoffs
screens.caption: A readable workflow showing contributions, dependencies and the human decision.
screens.spec:
Agent team navigation active. Breadcrumb "Agent team / Northstar renewal". Title "Renew Northstar without losing margin". Header "SEK 240k opportunity · Accountable owner Johan". Status "Waiting for your decision".
Main surface a clean large left-to-right SWIMLANE diagram, only four lanes with human-friendly labels: "Alex · Sales AI agent", "Laura · Finance AI agent", "Ben · Support AI agent", "Johan · Decision owner". Columns "Gather evidence", "Review terms", "Decision", "Delivery".
Draw readable rectangular nodes: Alex "Renewal brief · Completed"; Laura "Margin check · Completed"; Ben "Service history · Completed"; results feed Alex node "Proposal revised · Ready"; arrow into Johan amber node "Approve 8% discount · Waiting"; arrow then to hollow node "Send proposal · Not started". Edges labeled with actual handed-off artifacts: "Pricing brief", "Margin floor", "Open-case summary". Make all edges unambiguous and avoid spaghetti.
Below diagram concise discrepancy panel "Resolved disagreement: Sales requested 12%; Finance recommended 8%; revised proposal uses 8%." Link "View evidence".
Right rail "Decision required" shows before/after commercial terms, evidence links, owner and deadline 11:00. Primary "Review terms"; secondary "Request changes". Mini progress "3 evidence checks completed · Decision pending". Bottom tab strip "Flow", "Timeline", "Outputs", "History". No raw model reasoning, tokens, or simulated agent chat.

screens.title: Settings — autonomy by task type
screens.caption: Four explicit levels, company limits, task-specific grants and a change preview.
screens.spec:
Settings navigation active. Breadcrumb "Settings / Agent autonomy". Title "Set how your AI team may act". Top compact global strip "Company ceiling: Act within limits" and separate outlined red "Pause all agent execution". Company default small control "Organize".
Central large accessible four-position segmented step control (discrete not continuous gauge), exact labels "1 Advise", "2 Organize", "3 Do internal work", "4 Act within limits". Level 4 blue selected for the selected task, not the whole company. Supporting line "Editing task type: Routine support replies". Plain text "May send approved FAQ replies to verified customers. Exceptions still need review."
Below left compact policy matrix columns "Task type", "Configured", "Effective rule". Rows "Routine support replies / Act within limits / Known FAQ only"; "Sales discounts / Advise / Approval required"; "Payment release / Advise / Authorized approval"; "Campaign drafts / Do internal work / Internal only". Selected first row blue.
Below right task constraints form "Approved knowledge only", "Verified customers", "No refunds or commitments", "Maximum 40 replies per day", "Grant expires 31 Oct 2026". Owner "Sofia, Support lead". State "Draft change".
Right rail "Preview before applying" contains clearly labeled "Simulation on 50 past cases" and "37 eligible to send", "11 would require review", "2 would be blocked". Explain "No live actions performed". Policy block "Company limits and required approvals always apply". Bottom primary button "Apply task policy", secondary "Cancel". Show small before/after "Advise → Act within limits". Separate pause from numbered levels; no 'full autonomy' label.
